questRewardData.carries: every quest reward as PoB2 stores it: act/area/source identity, the reward line, the weapon-set skill points it grants, the selectable Options of a choice quest, and whether PoB2 applies it from the config (useConfig)

skillData.source: PathOfBuilding-PoE2-master/src/Data/Skills/*.lua + src/Data/Gems.lua (PoB2's own game-data export, workspace copy)
skillData.carries: attack baseMultiplier/attackSpeedMultiplier per gem level, per-level critChance/cooldown/costs, qualityStats, and every effect variant's ordered stat-id list with per-level values (e.g. Flame Wall's projectile added damage); plus the gem gameId -> grantedEffectId join PoB2 itself uses

uniqueData.carries: every unique identity with its base type, item class, variant list (including the Selected Variant PoB2 marks as live), implicits count and modifier lines with their {variant:N}/{tags:...} filters; the pinned RePoE catalog has identities only, so this is what makes unique modifiers available to the calculation and the item editor

transformation: released item/flask bases in supported classes; structured properties; implicit stat ids via mods.json; LocalIdentity attribute requirements (0.1.0 dump, unverified for current patch); per-gem first stat set per-level values and costs; default monster stats 1..100; tree statmap by reverse-translation of GGG stat_translations (unresolved lines reported, never guessed). Recommendations are not compatibility rules. v3: pools are unions per item class (prefix/suffix) plus the per-class corrupted implicit pool; mods_by_base [corrupted] kind is included. Corruption support is data-only: the game applies at most one corrupted implicit per item.
